title: Exact comparison rows before local continuity
statement: Let I be a directed preorder, R:I→CommRing a diagram and c a colimit cocone with IsColimit witness. Fix i∈I, a scheme X [def-pc-scheme], and s₀:X→Spec(R_i), locally finitely presented, quasi-compact and quasi-separated. Assume derived categories [def-pc-derived-category] of modules on every scheme exist in the fixed universe w. Let U,V be opens of X with U compact and V affine. Let t:Y→X be an open immersion with range U∪V, and s:Y→Spec(R_i) equal to t≫s₀, locally finitely presented, quasi-compact and quasi-separated. Assume the localized module-site derived categories on every open of Y exist in universe w. Fix perfect P,Q in D(O_Y) [def-pc-perfect-complex]. Supply a functor H:tail(≥i)→Type(max u w), a cocone d with IsColimit witness, and ident_j:H_j≃Hom(P_j,Q_j), where P_j,Q_j are the derived pullbacks [def-pc-derived-pullback]. Assume ident identifies all H transitions with perfectStageMap [lem-pc-perfect-hom-transport]. Then there exist exact five-term rows A,B of abelian groups, a morphism φ:A→B, equivalences a:d.pt≃A₂ and b:B₂≃Hom(P_limit,Q_limit), and the equation b(φ₂(a(d.ι_j(f))))=perfectLimitMap(ident_j(f)) for every stage representative. Each of φ₀,φ₁,φ₃,φ₄ satisfies PerfectHomLocalMap(U,V,-) [def-pc-perfect-hom-local-map]. There are no local-continuity hypotheses and no isomorphism assertion. Colimits are in the sense of [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit].

proof.text: Pull the cover U,V back to the presenting scheme Y and all its ring stages. Restrict the local strictly perfect models using the localized derived pullback comparison, so restrictions remain perfect; shifts remain perfect by thick closure. Perfect Q has quasi-coherent cohomology. The preimages of the two compact opens are compact and their intersection is compact by quasi-separatedness.

source.place: Tag 09RE, Mayer--Vietoris induction step; Cohomology Tag 08BW; online source checked 2026-10-13

proof.text: Use the derived Mayer--Vietoris triangle at each stage and at the limit. Apply Hom(P,-), including the preceding shift. Derived open adjunction identifies the five terms as the product on U,V in degree -1, the intersection in degree -1, the global Hom, the product on U,V in degree zero, and the intersection in degree zero. They are exact rows of abelian groups. Use the functorial K-injective resolution and short-exact-sequence boundary construction of these triangles, not independently chosen arbitrary distinguished triangles; naturality of that construction is what makes the transition comparisons coherent.

source.place: Tag 09RE, Mayer--Vietoris induction step; Cohomology Tag 08BW; online source checked 2026-10-13

proof.text: For a transition h apply the direct-image Mayer--Vietoris comparison to Lh*Q and then its naturality to the adjunction unit Q -> Rh*Lh*Q. Applying Hom(P,-) and derived adjunction gives all four commuting squares, including the connecting morphism. Identify the local comparisons through open restriction. At the central term cancellation of the counit-pinned composition comparisons gives exactly perfectStageMap and perfectLimitMap. Explicitly, the adjunction unit sends a stage arrow f to f followed by the unit on Q. Its adjunct is pullback(f), followed by pullback of that unit and the counit at the pulled-back Q. The adjunction triangle identity cancels the last two factors. Conjugating by the fixed composition comparisons is exactly perfectStageMap. The identical calculation for a cocone leg gives perfectLimitMap. The pinned direct-image composition comparisons on opens identify units with units of composite adjunctions, so the same cancellation supplies the local representative equations.

source.place: Tag 09RE, Mayer--Vietoris induction step; Cohomology Tag 08BW; online source checked 2026-10-13

proof.text: The central stage Hom sets with their canonical transitions form a functor, and the supplied ident identifies this functor with H. Take the filtered abelian-group colimit of all five stage rows; exactness is preserved. The underlying sets of this filtered group colimit form the set colimit. Thus uniqueness of colimits gives a from the supplied d, and the central Hom group at the limit gives b. The comparison from the previous step induces φ, and its central representative equation is exactly the required perfectLimitMap pinning. For each neighboring perfect pair construct its actual stage Hom system using perfect_hom_stage_colimit, so its local comparison has a pinned set-colimit presentation.

source.place: Tag 09RE, Mayer--Vietoris induction step; Cohomology Tag 08BW; online source checked 2026-10-13

proof.text: For each neighboring local term retain its actual presenting scheme, restricted perfect pair (with the degree -1 shift where appropriate), filtered Hom colimit, transition identifications and pinning equations. These are exactly the witnesses of PerfectHomLocalComparison. The two U,V terms are products of two such maps, and adjunction and colimit identifications transport them by equivalences. Thus all four neighboring maps satisfy PerfectHomLocalMap. Do not assume continuity and do not assert that these maps are isomorphisms.

theorem perfect_hom_mayerVietoris_local_rows
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (R : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) (c : Cocone R) (hc : IsColimit c)
    (i : I) (X : Scheme.{u}) (s₀ : X ⟶ Spec (R.obj i))
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation s₀] [QuasiCompact s₀] [QuasiSeparated s₀]
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    (U V : X.Opens) (hU : IsCompact (U : Set X)) (hV : IsAffineOpen V)
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) (t : Y ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion t]
    (ht : t.opensRange = U ⊔ V)
    (s : Y ⟶ Spec (R.obj i)) (hs : s = t ≫ s₀)
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation s] [QuasiCompact s] [QuasiSeparated s]
    [∀ W : Y.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace).over W))]
    (P Q : schemeDerivedCategory Y) (hP : Y.IsPerfect P) (hQ : Y.IsPerfect Q)
    (H : Set.Ici i ⥤ Type (max u w)) (d : Cocone H)
    (hd : IsColimit d)
    (ident : ∀ j : Set.Ici i, H.obj j ≃
      ((derivedPullback (pullback.fst s (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE j.property))))).obj P ⟶
       (derivedPullback (pullback.fst s (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE j.property))))).obj Q))
    (htransition : ∀ (j k : Set.Ici i) (hjk : j ≤ k) (f : H.obj j),
      ident k (H.map (homOfLE hjk) f) =
        perfectStageMap R s j.property hjk (ident j f)) :
        ∃ (A B : ComposableArrows AddCommGrpCat.{max u w} 4) (φ : A ⟶ B)
          (a : d.pt ≃ A.obj' 2)
          (b : B.obj' 2 ≃
            ((derivedPullback (pullback.fst s (Spec.map (c.ι.app i)))).obj P ⟶
             (derivedPullback (pullback.fst s (Spec.map (c.ι.app i)))).obj Q)),
          A.Exact ∧ B.Exact ∧
          PerfectHomLocalMap R c i X s₀ U V (ComposableArrows.app' φ 0) ∧
          PerfectHomLocalMap R c i X s₀ U V (ComposableArrows.app' φ 1) ∧
          PerfectHomLocalMap R c i X s₀ U V (ComposableArrows.app' φ 3) ∧
          PerfectHomLocalMap R c i X s₀ U V (ComposableArrows.app' φ 4) ∧
          ∀ (j : Set.Ici i) (f : H.obj j),
            b ((ComposableArrows.app' φ 2) (a (d.ι.app j f))) =
              perfectLimitMap R c s j.property (ident j f)
